items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I was with Milt Senior there... Melvin Bowles... also joined Milt Senior from the Speed Webb beside me.

ctx.x: Yeah, right. So when did you get to Chicago?

Well, after the Speed Webb band, something happened in Toledo, Ohio, and I got an offer from Milt Senior -- Milt Senior was one of the alto players with the McKinney's Cotton Pickers band in Detroit, and he left the band, and went home to Toledo and had his own little group at the Chateau de France Roadhouse, in those days -- Eckland State House
in the suburbs of Toledo, and his pianist was Art Tatum.
